prompt:
A single game icon of a potion vessel, painted in a rustic 1990s hand-painted trading-card style (gouache and ink, antique colours, slightly worn), bold and simple so it still reads at 48 pixels. Straight front view, symmetrical, the vessel fills most of the frame, on a fully transparent background. The vessel has one large round body of clear glass filled about three quarters full with glowing liquid; the front of the body is plain and undecorated, an open area of liquid where a number will be printed in the middle. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no badge or circle behind it, no drop shadow, no table or surface.

Subject: Mana potion of Sun Wukong: a calabash-gourd-shaped flask of clear glass, a small upper bulb and a large round lower bulb, a red silk cord with a tassel tied at its waist, a gold stopper, filled with glowing golden elixir of immortality; the number goes in the big lower bulb.
